propositions: set_baseline unconditionally wrote a never-read baseline_advanced_at timestamp that changed 1,144 entries across 40 revisions, causing pathological git delta churn in an 18 MB file

The timestamp write is now eliminated and set_baseline implements an early-return guard that skips writes when the stored baseline equals the new baseline, preserving byte-identical output for unchanged input
Consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state now produce byte-identical bindings.json and no new commits

The guard preserves None-valued baseline fields through round-trip serialization and applies consistently across three call sites: set_baseline, seed_baselines_from_snapshot, and inbound-adopt dynamic call
Packed-cost measurement over 40 historical revisions shows marginal delta reduced from 13.84 KiB/version to 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of baseline, within the 25% acceptance threshold)
